description: Abstract class for managing subscription updates and data replication in a pub/sub system, serving as a base for subclasses like SubUpdater and AcksUpdater.

classes.name: AbstractUpdater
classes.description: Abstract base class for pub/sub subscription management and data replication, parameterized by topic and payload types.

classes.name: Subscribe
classes.description: Request class for subscribing to topics with optional filtering and acknowledgment.

classes.name: Unsubscribe
classes.description: Request class for unsubscribing from topics.

classes.name: RemoveSubscriber
classes.description: Request class for removing a subscriber, with support for acknowledgment label declaration.

classes.name: SubAck
classes.description: Acknowledgment message for subscription requests, containing request details, sender, and sequence number.

classes.name: DeclareAckLabels
classes.description: Request to declare acknowledgment labels for a subscriber, convertible to a subscription request.

classes.name: DDataOpSuccess
classes.description: Internal class indicating successful completion of a distributed data operation, parameterized by payload type.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior for the actor, including subscription, unsubscription, termination, data operation success, failure, and clock ticks.

methods.name: ddataOpSuccess
methods.description: Abstract method to handle successful data operations, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to handle subscription requests, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Abstract method to handle unsubscription requests, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Abstract method to handle clock tick events, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: updateFailure
methods.description: Handles data update failures by logging error and marking subscriptions as changed for retry.

methods.name: forceUpdate
methods.description: Determines probabilistically if the next update should be a forced update based on configuration.

methods.name: enqueueRequest
methods.description: Adds a subscription request to the appropriate queue, updating write consistency and acknowledgment status.

methods.name: getSeqNr
methods.description: Returns the last sequence number used for acknowledgment messages.

methods.name: exportAwaitSubAck
methods.description: Exports pending acknowledgment messages up to a specified sequence number.

methods.name: moveAwaitUpdateToAwaitAcknowledge
methods.description: Transfers pending updates to acknowledgment queue after a data write.

methods.name: handleDDataWriteResult
methods.description: Creates a callback function to handle the result of a distributed data write operation.

methods.name: terminated
methods.description: Handles actor termination by removing the actor from subscriptions.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber actor from the subscription list.

methods.name: doRemoveSubscriber
methods.description: Performs the actual removal of a subscriber actor.

methods.name: upgradeWriteConsistency
methods.description: Upgrades the write consistency level if the new level is more global.

methods.name: isMoreConsistent
methods.description: Compares two write consistency levels to determine which is more global.

methods.name: rank
methods.description: Assigns a rank to a write consistency level, from most local to most global.
